The '''Eol Sha Colony''' was a colony created by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in order to relocate the survivors from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eol Sha]]. It was [[Attack on Dantooine (Galactic Civil War)|destroyed]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11]] [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala's]] [[Maw fleet|fleet]].
